concrete_findings.expected: For one member, native accuracy uses raw FP32 z[0].argmax(-1); for four members, native accuracy uses FP32 mean-softmax argmax.
concrete_findings.observed_static_behavior: The shared native_class is FP32 softmax/mean argmax for both bank sizes and is used in raw-native fold and aggregate accuracy.
concrete_findings.reason: FP32 probability rounding can produce a tie when raw logits have a distinct maximum.
concrete_findings.required_repair: Separate native_scoring_class from native_class. Use raw-logit argmax for single native scoring, preserve softmax-based graph native_class, and use native_scoring_class in raw-native fold and aggregate metrics.
